name: What does LEED certification mean for residential projects?

mainEntity.name: What does LEED certification mean for residential projects?

acceptedAnswer.text: LEED (Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design) verifies that homes meet rigorous standards for energy savings, water efficiency, sustainable sites, materials, and indoor environmental quality through third-party verification. inogenalliance+1
